content: Letter 21, to Amīr Fīrūzshāh: Ibn Turka greets the amir, hopes his success will be furthered by the prayers and spiritual support of Sufis, and petitions him to instruct his deputies (nuvvāb) to receive the bearer, Shaykh Burhān al-Dīn Amīr Shaykh b. Shaykh Taqī l-Dīn Dādā, for whose character and learning he vouches and who has a few requests to make (TMN/MS pp. 17-18, TMN/D pp. 183-84). MK's footnote places Shaykh Taqī l-Dīn Dādā's mausoleum and khanaqah at Yazd and its environs.
